subject: FinFlux May 4 inference degradation — RCA, timeline, and action items
messages:
From: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina@finflux.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinFlux Engineering <eng@finflux.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: formal RCA and timeline for May 4 degradation

Tessa —

Thanks again for the quick updates during the May 4 incident. We still need a formal RCA and an evidence-backed timeline for our internal audit and ledger reconciliation teams. High-level asks:

- Confirm root cause and the exact window where inference outputs were degraded and token counts were underreported.
- Provide a minute-by-minute timeline (server timestamps, model variant, region).
- List concrete mitigations and owners for each action, with target dates.
- Cost/token reconciliation guidance and any proposed financial remediation (credits) since we compute billable units differently.

This incident affected several production pipelines; our compliance team will want attachments (evidence artifacts) and verification steps. If you can share a draft by EOD May 7 that would be ideal — otherwise we'll take a readout next week.

Appreciate it —
Sabrina Lowe
Head of Platform Reliability
FinFlux

Attachment: none
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina@finflux.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: formal RCA and timeline for May 4 degradation

Sabrina —

Thanks for the note and the clear asks. Short acknowledgement: we own this and will provide an evidence-backed RCA and a reconciliation packet. Attached is a preliminary RCA (redwood_inference_may4_rca_v1.pdf) and a CSV timeline stub; both are marked DRAFT. Key points up front:

- Summary: a cross-service cache eviction combined with a model-variant rollout caused intermittent KV cache misses between 03:42–04:07 UTC on May 4. Misses resulted in partial context being dropped for long-session generations which reduced output token counts and caused tokenization discrepancies in our billing pipeline.
- Impact window: 03:42–04:07 UTC (25 minutes).
- Customer-visible effects: lower-than-expected output lengths for large-batch jobs and sporadic 5xx errors for sessions crossing shard boundaries.

What we're attaching now (DRAFT):
- redwood_inference_may4_rca_v1.pdf — narrative RCA with root cause, short-term fixes applied, and a proposed verification plan.
- timeline_may4_tokens.csv — preliminary minute-level timeline with service traces and token deltas.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-minute readout with your SRE and compliance teams on Mon, May 10 at 15:00 PT. Please confirm.
2) We'll finalize an evidence bundle (logs, traces, KV cache snapshots) and a reconciliation matrix for billable tokens by May 12.
3) Proposed mitigations (in the draft RCA) include a fixed rollout gating check, additional pre-rollout KV retention checks, and a reconciliation job to re-run token counts against archived traces.

We're capturing owners below:
- David Kim (Runtime Ops) — finalize verification tests and run reconciliation job (target: 2027-05-12).
- Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — coordinate readout and acceptance checklist with FinFlux (target: 2027-05-10).
- Tessa Morgan (Account lead) — deliver final RCA and credits proposal (target: 2027-05-12).

I'll follow up with the calendar invite once you confirm the readout.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_inference_may4_rca_v1.pdf (DRAFT), timeline_may4_tokens.csv (DRAFT)
From: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina@finflux.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinFlux Engineering <eng@finflux.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: formal RCA and timeline for May 4 degradation

Tessa —

Appreciate the quick draft. Confirming Monday May 10 15:00 PT works for our side. A couple of asks for the readout: please include

- A token-level reconciliation plan (how you’ll compare recorded vs. re-processed tokens) and expected timeline for completion.
- Evidence artifacts that your compliance team will provide so our audit can validate (log extracts, KV snapshots, hash/checksums).
- Any interim mitigations we should enable on our side to avoid re-occurrence during your rollout window.

We'll have our SRE (eng@finflux.com) on the call.

Thanks,
Sabrina
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina@finflux.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final: FinFlux May 4 RCA, timeline, and action ledger (follow-up from readout)

Sabrina / FinFlux SRE —

Thanks again for the readout today. As promised, attached are the finalized artifacts: redwood_inference_may4_rca_v1.pdf (final) and timeline_may4_tokens.csv (minute-level ledger). Below is a concise closure summary and action ledger copied from the readout for your records.

Executive summary:
- Root cause: During a rolling model-variant deployment, an incompatible KV cache update path triggered partial cache eviction across a subset of routing shards. This produced KV misses that reduced available context for long-session generations between 03:42–04:07 UTC, causing reduced output token counts and occasional 5xx errors for some sessions.
- What we fixed immediately (May 4): aborted the rollout at 03:47 UTC, reverted to stable variant, and rehydrated KV caches for affected shards by 04:15 UTC.
- Verification: we ran synthetic replay of affected sessions against archived traces and verified token counts matched expected outputs after rehydration.

Action ledger (owners & dates):
- David Kim (Runtime Ops): implement pre-rollout KV-compatibility check and add gate to rollout pipeline (target: 2027-05-20).
- David Kim (Runtime Ops): deliver reconciliation job that reprocesses archived traces and produces a billable-token delta report (target: 2027-05-12).
- Marissa Cole (Customer Success): compile acceptance checklist and evidence bundle for FinFlux audit (target: 2027-05-12).
- Tessa Morgan (Account lead): provide credits proposal and finalize SLA note on accounting for the incident (target: 2027-05-12).

Reconciliation summary (high-level):
- Preliminary reconciliation indicates ~0.14% undercount vs. expected tokens for affected large-batch jobs during the impact window. Detailed token deltas are in timeline_may4_tokens.csv. Our reconciliation job will produce a definitive billable-delta by May 12.

Verification artifacts included:
- service traces (sampled) and their checksums;
- KV cache snapshot digest for affected shards;
- replay logs from verification runs.

Next steps for FinFlux:
- Review attached final RCA and timeline. If acceptable, confirm via reply and we will route the credits proposal and final audit bundle.
- If you need additional forensic detail (full traces), indicate which date ranges and we will queue an export (may take 48–72 hours for complete datasets).

Please confirm acceptance or next questions.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan

Redwood Inference
